newsitem.title: USA: De Silguy sees "fast-track" EU talks Apr/May '98.
newsitem.headline: De Silguy sees "fast-track" EU talks Apr/May '98.

text.p: European Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy said on Monday he expected a "fast-track" meeting in early 1998 where finance ministers will meet immediately before and after EU leaders decide which countries qualify to join monetary union in 1999.
EU leaders are due to meet during a weekend in late April/early May to decide which countries will join the new euro currency from the start.

De Silguy told reporters the summit would be immediately preceded by a finance ministers' meeting, while these ministers would also meet immediately after to wrap up any details needed to implement the leaders' decision.
EU ministers are keen to make all decisions neccessary in the April/May weekend to avoid encouraging financial market speculation. REUTER
